name: MEROPS fixed-wing interceptor
description: Fast fixed-wing interceptor with fragmentation warhead; Ukraine-proven vs Shahed-class OWA. 5-20 km envelope.

maxRangeM.condition: range of roughly 5 to 20 km; 20000 m at the top of the envelope

flyoutSpeedMps.condition: up to 280 km/h, a maximum (78 m/s)

seekerAcquisitionRangeM.note: Open reporting says the interceptor acquires on radio frequency, radar or thermal sensors but gives no acquisition range. Not established by the public record.

lethalRadiusM.note: Class median of the one sourced interceptor warhead radius: the APKWS M151 burst radius of 10 m (lib-eagls). MEROPS carries a reported 2 kg fragmentation warhead against the 3.95 kg M151, so 10 m sits at the generous end. No lethal radius is published. A one-member median is thin; it is recorded as such so a later source replaces it cleanly.

guidanceNoiseM.note: Planning factor: 2 m 1 sigma terminal guidance noise for a proximity-fuzed interceptor. The one sourced member of the class, the semi-active laser APKWS at better than 1 m CEP, sits at the accurate end; this seeker's accuracy is not published.

maxFlyoutSpeedMps.condition: speeds up to 280 km/h (77.8 m/s); the average flyoutSpeedMps carries the same figure because only the maximum is reported
maxFlyoutSpeedMps.source: Inside Unmanned Systems, quoted from the search index

boostTimeS.note: A propeller-driven fixed-wing interceptor with no boost motor; no acceleration profile is published.
